mechanism: Amikacin (aminoglycoside) may enhance the hypoglycemic effect of glimepiride through potential pancreatic beta-cell stimulation and reduced glucose clearance, while also increasing nephrotoxicity risk in patients with renal impairment.
action: Monitor blood glucose levels closely; consider alternative antibiotic if possible; assess renal function baseline and regularly; adjust glimepiride dose if hypoglycemia occurs.
